fixes.explanation: Careful, friend, this one is true. Ezra 2:63 says, "The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim." So it's a hold until a priest is there to consult them. I waited years in the back of a junk drawer, so I know how long "until" can feel.

Right, it's False. Ezra 2:68 says they gave "…to rebuild the house of God on its original site." So the plan was to put it back where it stood, not to start over somewhere new. That's like me never moving my ovens once the kitchen is set up around them. The ovens stay put and the baking goes on.
